items.note: RepairPal lists J30 timing belt replacement at about $1,864-$2,411.
Rear-bank manifolds take more labor. One owner reported about $1,200 at the dealer.

items.t: Hesitation or bucking from a bad knock sensor
items.note: Sensors run about $60-$90 aftermarket or $120-$150 from the dealer; the intake manifold has to come off.

items.t: Harsh shifts or slipping automatic transmission
items.job: Transmission fluid service and code check
items.note: YourMechanic estimates about $280-$300 for a J30 fluid service. If the transmission is already slipping, a rebuild or replacement costs far more.

items.t: Hard to start when hot or won't start at times
items.job: No-start diagnosis (spark and fuel pressure test)
items.note: This is the diagnosis only. CarComplaints owners of the earlier J30 report an average of about $400 to fix intermittent no-starts.

items.t: Low or unstable idle from a dirty throttle body
items.note: YourMechanic estimates about $220 for a 1996-1997 J30.

items.t: Check engine light from EVAP purge valve
items.note: YourMechanic averages about $380; its per-year J30 estimate is about $615.

items.t: Clogged sunroof drains leak water inside
items.note: Clearing drains usually costs no more than a few hundred dollars. Water damage to the engine computer or carpet costs extra.
Check the fuse and relay first, which costs little. A broken track or cable can push the job past $800.

items.t: Power windows fail or move by themselves
items.note: RepairPal lists J30 window regulator replacement at about $494-$586.

items.t: Worn control arm bushings and struts
items.note: YourMechanic lists about $730-$910 per arm for 1996-1997 J30s depending on position. Struts are extra, and an alignment is usually needed afterward.
YourMechanic lists about $575-$745 per door for 1996-1997 J30s.

items.t: A/C stops cooling on long trips
items.note: RepairPal lists an A/C recharge at about $292-$391; leaks or a bad part add to that.

items.job: Adjust or free parking brake cable
items.note: An adjustment alone is about $95; a seized cable adds parts.
